From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Skill Syndicate / Redwood — Onboarding & SkillLift request

Hi Eleanor —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Per our conversation, Redwood is ready to kick off a focused onboarding for Skill Syndicate (we're calling the program "SkillLift"). The goal is to get a first production-ready integration for your consulting delivery workflow in 6 weeks:

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45m):
- Introductions + primary contacts
- Scope: first 2 use cases (agent-assist for proposals, post-engagement summarization)
- Access needs (sandbox, API keys, SI guides)
- Training plan: enablement sessions + lab schedule
- Success criteria & quick-win milestones

Ask from your side: can you please return the attached onboarding survey (Redwood_SI_Onboard_Survey_v1.xlsx) with answers for your typical delivery profile and list of pilot customers? Also attach any org overview or SOC/infosec contact we should engage. I attached a short MOP template (SkillLift_Onboarding_MOP_v1.pdf) that we’ll use to track responsibilities.

I can run the kickoff meeting next week. Our team is available:
- Tue 6/8 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 6/9 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 6/10 09:30–10:30 PT

Please pick one or propose a time. Once you confirm, I’ll post a calendar invite and add pre-read links.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Skill Syndicate ramped.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Partner Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SI_Onboard_Survey_v1.xlsx, SkillLift_Onboarding_MOP_v1.pdf

From: Eleanor Briggs <eleanor@skillsyndicate.com>

Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@skillsyndicate.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Skill Syndicate / Redwood — Onboarding & SkillLift request

Alex —

Thanks — excited to get going. Tue 6/8 10:00 PT works for me and Marco. We reviewed the MOP and the survey — we'll fill out the XLSX and return it by EOD Monday.

Two quick asks from our side before kickoff:
1) Can you share a short security checklist or SOC/infosec contact? Our compliance team will need to validate data handling and retention (we often require an architecture diagram and the SOC-2 matrix).
2) We use Okta SSO for our consultants. Can you confirm if Redwood supports SAML/Okta for the partner portal (even read-only access) or whether we'll share dedicated API credentials for the sandbox?

I attached a brief org overview (SkillSyndicate_Org_Overview.pdf) and Marco will be on the call to discuss pilot customers and timeline.

See you Tue 10:00 PT.

—Eleanor
Eleanor Briggs
Head of Partnerships | Skill Syndicate Consulting
eleanor@skillsyndicate.com | +1 617-555-9987

Attachments: SkillSyndicate_Org_Overview.pdf

Subject: Fwd: Skill Syndicate / Redwood — Onboarding & SkillLift request

Alex / Sean — forwarding Eleanor's note and org overview. Quick internal plan:

- Security/compliance: Sean, can you take point on a short one-page checklist (SOC-2 matrix + what we need for partner sandbox access)? We should include a network diagram and retention policy.
- SSO: Vanessa, confirm SAML/Okta support for partner portal and whether we need a transient developer tenant for Skill Syndicate.
- Enablement: Alex, I'll organize a 3-session enablement track (Platform intro, Integration lab, Delivery best practices). Sessions will be 60–90 minutes and we should record them.

I also propose we add a "pilot owner" from Solutions — Ben Carter or Mina Haddad would be good. Ben is available during the week of 6/14 and can co-lead the integration lab.

I'll draft a short internal action tracker and share before EOD.

Camila Reyes
Sr. Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference
